title: Source metrics dashboard cards
summary: This iteration turns the source-first metrics dashboard from a markdown table into visible operational metric cards, making effective, updated, blocked, skipped, and low-signal source states scannable before story tracks.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source metrics dashboard cards|source-first runtime contract|source-first IA dashboard|source inventory|source map scan index" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Source metrics need a visible card contract, not only a markdown table.
lessons.evidence: `source-first-dashboard` now emits an effective-interact `filterable-cards` section with `source-metric-card` cards for total, included, updated-not-selected, blocked, skipped, and low-signal states.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future source dashboard refinements on the same public-safe card contract.

lessons.lesson: Failure states should stay visible even when counts are zero.
lessons.evidence: Blocked, skipped, and low-signal cards are always present in the fixed six-card order instead of disappearing when the count is small.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the same always-visible rule for future source health and freshness summaries.

lessons.lesson: The source dashboard can become more visual without changing collection or ranking behavior.
lessons.evidence: The implementation only changes `reportToInteractionInput` section shaping and tests; source registry, source inventory count, collection, candidate scoring, and automation behavior remain untouched.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue separating presentation iterations from source collection/ranking iterations.

followups.action: Draft the source insertion handbook and owner-maintained fixed importance order before adding or moving more registered sources.
